turns.text: Dubai property prices dropped almost 50% in less than a year. I'm talking about 2008. Could the same thing happen again in 2026? At first glance, the similarities around are uncomfortable. Record prices, then off plan frenzy, buyers rushing into the market because they're afraid of missing the next increase. But the mechanism underneath today's market is completely different. In 2008, the market was built on credit. Buyers were getting up to 90% finance, and flippers were reserving properties with very small deposits. Then lending stopped. Not only in Dubai, all over the world. The buyers did not simply become cautious. They disappeared. Today, most purchases are cash. Mortgage lending is restricted and off plan is regulated. So, no, the risk is not identical, but that doesn't mean that there is no risk. In the full video, I'll explain what could actually pressure Dubai property prices in this cycle.
